summary: Electra Battery Materials filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing an extension of its cobalt hydroxide feed purchase agreement with Glencore AG through December 31, 2031. The deal secures 100% of feedstock for commissioning and ramp-up of Electra's Ontario cobalt sulfate refinery through 2027, covering roughly 10,000 metric tonnes of contained cobalt over five years, valued at over US$500 million at current market prices. This is an ordinary commercial supply contract, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or change of control is stated. Watch commissioning timing and offtake economics.
